title: Changing MCP tool scopes/description: edit tools.yaml and regenerate both schema JSONs
answers: how to change required scopes of an MCP tool
body:
Edit the source of truth in products/alerts/mcp/tools.yaml (scopes, description), then regenerate (PR used `hogli build:openapi`) so these change together:
- services/mcp/schema/generated-tool-definitions.json (`required_scopes`, `description`)
- services/mcp/schema/tool-definitions-all.json (same entries)
Do not hand-edit the JSONs. Scopes are not part of tool-schema snapshots, so no snapshot updates are needed. Regeneration may rewrite unrelated generated files; revert those.
Add a unit test in services/mcp/tests/unit using `getToolDefinition(name).required_scopes` with `hasScopes` to pin visibility for a given token scope set (including that mutation tools stay hidden from read-only tokens).
applies: MCP tool definitions generated from product tools.yaml files
